subject.title: [Bug]: Agent heartbeat routes to wrong agent's session instead of its own

question: Should maintainers require a live current-main reproduction of the global-scope secondary-agent heartbeat route before queueing a fix PR?
rationale: Source and reporter evidence are strong, but the fix likely touches compatibility-sensitive global session routing and the issue already carries maintainer-review and live-repro signals.

options.title: Run live repro first
options.body: Reproduce the WSL2 or Docker global-scope heartbeat case on current main, then queue a narrow fix with regression tests against the confirmed path.

options.title: Queue source-backed fix now
options.body: Accept the current source path and reporter evidence as sufficient and let a repair PR attempt a focused fix plus tests without live proof first.

options.title: Fold into broader session routing review
options.body: Keep this issue open but handle it alongside adjacent global-session and dmScope routing work before choosing the permanent contract.

recommendation.title: Run live repro first
recommendation.body: Reproduce the WSL2 or Docker global-scope heartbeat case on current main, then queue a narrow fix with regression tests against the confirmed path.

likelyOwner.reason: Current source blame and the prior overlapping cron preservation history make this the strongest available routing owner for the proof decision.
